subject: Post-discovery: proposal for demo window, CISO & procurement intro
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@finlytics.com>, Ian Mercer <ian@finlytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-29T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Post-discovery: proposal for demo window, CISO & procurement intro

Hi Claire / Ian — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum: 

- Recap: You want fast, predictable inference for your customer-facing insights pipelines, with SSO and strict audit/log retention.
- Ask: Schedule a technical deep dive (45–60m) where we demo the runtime behavior on a sample job and walk through SSO & evidence for your compliance team.

Proposed demo windows (PST):
- Option A: Tue 2027-09-07, 10:00–11:00
- Option B: Wed 2027-09-08, 15:00–16:00

Who to include: please loop in your CISO/InfoSec lead and procurement contact. I’m cc'ing Marissa (solutions) and Karthik (security lead) from our side; Markus will join if we scope SSO/infra.

Attachments: discovery notes + mutual action plan (attached) — short checklist and responsibilities.

Next steps: pick the preferred slot and confirm any additional stakeholders (CISO, procurement). If neither works, share two alternatives and we’ll pivot.

Thanks,
Marcus
Marcus Lin | Enterprise Sales 
Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Attachments:
- Redwood-Discovery-Notes-20270829.pdf (summary of call & technical constraints)
- Mutual-Action-Plan-FinLytics-v1.xlsx (proposed milestones)

From: Claire Zhao <claire@finlytics.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ian Mercer <ian@finlytics.com>, Rita Patel <rita.patel@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: 2027-08-29T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposal for demo window, CISO & procurement intro

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear write-up. Ian and I are aligned and can do Option B (Wed 2027-09-08, 15:00–16:00 PST).

Looping in Rita Patel (CISO) and procurement. Rita: we discussed SSO, log retention and an evidence bundle for SOC-style review — Marcus's team will demo how they handle audit logs and private deployments.

Procurement: can you confirm whether a pre-NDA is required for the demo materials? If there are contract templates we should review, please flag them.

Two quick asks before the demo:
1) Will you show a small run with our sample payload size (~1.2k tokens)?
2) Can we cover quantization/latency tradeoffs briefly?

Claire Zhao
Director, Data Products | FinLytics
claire@finlytics.com

On 2027-08-29 09:12, Marcus Lin wrote:
> Hi Claire / Ian — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and recommended next steps so we keep momentum:...

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Claire Zhao <claire@finlytics.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-29T12:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposal for demo window, CISO & procurement intro

Great — thanks Claire. Confirming Option B (2027-09-08, 15:00–16:00 PST) works on our side. Markus (cc) will take point on SSO/evidence; Karthik will cover compliance questions and the audit-log export.

Agenda (45–60m):
- 10m: quick business recap & success criteria (Claire/Ian)
- 25m: live demo with a 1.2k token sample (we'll run a short job and surface latency/cost)
- 15m: SSO, retention, and evidence bundle for Rita + procurement Q&A
- 5m: confirm MAP milestones and next steps

Marcus will send a calendar invite and attach a minimal runner we can use for the demo. Claire — for procurement, if you can share any template clauses or an NDA link we’ll pre-review and mark any redlines.

Thanks — looking forward to it.
Marissa Cole | Solutions Engineer 
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

Attachments: none

From: Ian Mercer <ian@finlytics.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Claire Zhao <claire@finlytics.com>, Rita Patel <rita.patel@finlytics.com>, procurement@finlytics.com
Date: 2027-08-30T10:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Post-discovery: proposal for demo window, CISO & procurement intro

All set from our side — Option B looks good. I'll expect a calendar invite with dial-in and a brief runbook for the 1.2k token test. Procurement has shared a standard NDA; procurement@finlytics.com, please attach the doc to the invite or send a link.

Rita — let us know if you'd prefer a separate 30m pre-demo to review the evidence expectations; otherwise we'll cover the items during the main session.

Thanks,
Ian
Principal Product Manager | FinLytics
ian@finlytics.com
